review_notes: Reviewed the actual top-level proposal.json, not the different proposal embedded in context.prior_result. All 78 proposal lines, all 44 functionality lines, all 791 fact-disposition lines and all 845 link-disposition lines were read.

All three proposed writes are supported and address owned subjects. The two state_behavior writes accurately distinguish local guarded operations from downstream guarantees; the TU purpose write correctly describes the four SpecialN helpers through active consumers. No proposed entities, merges, links or follow-ups are present.

The current top-level ledgers are materially more conservative than the librarian packet embedded in context. In particular, they explicitly defer cleanup-safety, launch, visual-enclosure and upstream Inhale claims. Those deferrals are appropriate and are preserved below.

Canonical and rendered forms of the complete owned source were examined. Rendered substitutions were not used as evidence. The active Kirby motion table, explicit Hammer constructor, Hammer owner notification, shared lifecycle handlers, item position consumer, star-state consumers, shared physics routines and landing override were independently checked.
The repair verdict concerns the malformed canonical evidence locator in the submitted ledger. It is not a rejection of any of the three proposed fact values.

Retained descriptions of physics and cleanup are limited to their demonstrated call sequence and normal sequential use. They do not establish tuning positivity, finite-value guarantees, reentrancy, alias invalidation or complete engine lifetime contracts.
No shared artifact, source, database or public-message mutation was performed.
